decisions.Q1: pilot three source industry labels; keep all jobs
decisions.Q2: domain, tools, technology and languages; no soft skills
decisions.Q3: include required and preferred; do not call all mandatory
decisions.Q4: allow language inference from finite certificate mapping, retain evidence; do not infer proficiency
decisions.Q5: two blind AI reviewers approved; not human ground truth
decisions.Q6: Content writing/editing/creation counts as Content Marketing only with clear marketing context in requirements.
decisions.Q7: Allow digital shorthand only with clear marketing context in requirements.
decisions.Q8: ID 532645 office IT clause is required prior training; finite exact-text override, not every bare training phrase.
decisions.Q9: Trung (Anh) in language context includes English; do not assert both are mandatory.
decisions.Q10: Include image/banner/graphic design and photo/video production in Content Marketing only with clear marketing context inside requirements; keep named tools separately.
decisions.Q11: Include explicitly recruited ad skills even when zero experience and fallback training are accepted (ID 273532). Business pairs do not distinguish required/preferred; do not include mere unrelated or future-training-only mentions.

limits: Literal canonical names plus finite aliases; no automatic split of composite labels
Review claims remain ID/hash bound; never globalize owner-specific inference
601 concepts are a finite vocabulary, not guaranteed exhaustive coverage

context_overrides.evidence: Được đào tạo Tin học văn phòng

expanded_owner_decisions.specialist_labels: Quyết toán thuế, Kê khai thuế, Quản trị Fanpage use specialist concepts; broad group needs separate explicit evidence
expanded_owner_decisions.content_parent: Preserve Content Marketing rollup for explicit media-production capabilities in marketing context in requirements
expanded_owner_decisions.generic_and_tool: Take both if both are explicit, e.g. phần mềm kế toán MISA; no generic inference from MISA alone
expanded_owner_decisions.new_photo_editing: Existing owner authorization allows new professional skills with direct evidence; image editing kept distinct from image design
expanded_owner_decisions.marketing_degree_only: Degree/major alone cannot establish marketing context for Content Marketing; retain explicit media skills
expanded_owner_decisions.keyword_scope: Keyword familiarity alone is not keyword research; require research/analysis/selection capability
